text: Merged cross-repo value flow (external intrinsics zeroed)
description: PARKED HISTORICAL AIM-LEVEL DESIGN — not the implemented repo-node model. This proposal would load referenced external aims, zero their intrinsic values, and eventually cascade into their subtrees when expanded. It was halted by the 2026-06-27 decision to use opaque whole-repository boundaries. The implemented successor is 3023ebec: exactly one zero-intrinsic leaf-sink node per linked repository, with no external graph loading or cascade.

status.comment: Parked 2026-06-27: repo-level-links-only pivot. Merged value flow over external AIMS (zeroed external intrinsics, cascade-on-expand) is replaced by a much simpler model — one zero-intrinsic leaf-sink node per linked repo. Superseded by the new 'repo-link value flow (repo node as leaf sink)' aim under e81b11c3.
